title: Domain events
objective: Events should be emitted after a committed operation, with durable delivery for critical side effects.
misconception: A task-created event is emitted before persistence succeeds, triggering false notifications.
acceptance: On a failed save, no success event is emitted; on confirmation, one event is raised.
securityBoundary: For durable notifications use an outbox or queue; process-local emitters can lose events.
